Package edu.kit.datamanager.takita.mainpage.dashboard

Interface IDashboardService

All Known Implementing Classes:
DashboardService
@Service public interface IDashboardService
Interface for Dashboard Service. Provides methods to get and set current ContentView and to get all implemented/available types of contentViews.
